nameEn: Manufacture of rubber tyres and tubes; retreading and rebuilding of rubber tyres
description: This class includes the manufacture of rubber tyres and tubes for all types of vehicles and aircraft, and the retreading and rebuilding of rubber tyres.
includes: manufacture of rubber tyres for cars, lorries, buses, bicycles, motorcycles, aircraft, tractors and other vehicles
manufacture of inner tubes for tyres
retreading and rebuilding of rubber tyres
manufacture of solid or cushion tyres
excludes: manufacture of rubber tubes, pipes and hoses, see 2219
manufacture of tyre cord fabric, see 1395
